references.text: Moses warns of curses that will come upon Israel if they abandon the Lord and do not keep his commands, a theme also found in Joshua's warning.
The Lord predicts that the people will forsake him and serve foreign gods, and that his anger will flare up against them.
Earlier in the same speech, Joshua warns that the Lord's wrath will come upon them if they break the covenant and serve other gods.
Describes how Israel abandoned the Lord and served foreign gods, leading to the Lord's judgment upon them.
The prophet Isaiah accuses the people of having forsaken the Lord, the source of living water, and dug cisterns for themselves that cannot hold water.
Warns that no sacrifice for sin remains for those who sin willfully after receiving the truth, but a terrible judgment awaits.
